claim_verbatim: If the removal machines fail to arrive at the scale the pathways assume, net zero by 2050 is a fantasy. Warming that passes 1.5°C stays above it.
context: Section on the IPCC 1.5°C pathways: 'Net zero, as the models draw it, is a house built on the logic of decarbonisation, and the removal machines are its load-bearing walls. A house whose load-bearing walls are still to be built exists on paper.' The essay sets BECCS at 3 to 7 billion tonnes a year by 2050 in the pathways against 1.3 million tonnes removed by all newer methods in 2024.
source: Substack essay 'Decarbonisation: The Fantasy upon which Net Zero is built.', ctindale.substack.com, 3 Nov 2026 06:00 UTC (3 Nov 2026 17:00 AEDT); republishes the 12 Oct 2026 X article 'Net-Zero by 2050 Came From Computer Models. So Did the Fictional Fantasy Machines That Make It Work.' (https://x.com/ctindale/status/2109528525762109557)
probability_words: is a fantasy / stays above it (declarative; read as 'will')
mechanism: Carbon dioxide removal machines (BECCS, direct air capture) not built at the scale the IPCC pathways assume, so there is no route to bring warming back below 1.5°C after overshoot.
